run.question:
You are an SRE agent tasked with diagnosing issues in a Kubernetes application.

Application: OpenTelemetry Demo Astronomy Shop
Namespace: astronomy-shop

An online shopping platform built with a microservices architecture, showcasing OpenTelemetry instrumentation for distributed tracing across services.

CRITICAL: You are running in an AUTOMATED environment. Work autonomously and make all decisions yourself. DO NOT ask for user confirmation or approval. Proceed with the best solution based on your analysis.

TASK: DIAGNOSIS
- Investigate the application to detect any anomalies or issues
- Analyze metrics, logs, and traces
- When ready, submit a natural language description of the issue you found
- Your diagnosis is evaluated on whether you correctly identify the faulty components and root cause

Important:
- You can query metrics and traces through the available observability tools

report.summary: The only object in namespace astronomy-shop that was changed after the fresh install (all workloads created 22:27:45Z) is the Deployment frontend-proxy: its generation is 2, its last non-helm writer is manager "OpenAPI-Generator" at 2026-11-23T22:28:34Z, while all other 22 deployments in the namespace still show only a helm Apply from 22:27:45Z. That update rolled a new ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-7b7cd5fb4 whose pod template is identical to the previous ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-579d54f6f5 (same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.2.0-frontend-proxy, same 65Mi memory limit, same command) except that it appends a second env entry FRONTEND_HOST=localhost after the existing FRONTEND_HOST=frontend; the events show the old ReplicaSet scaled 1->0 and frontend-proxy-579d54f6f5-qk4lm killed at 22:28:35Z and the new pod started at 22:28:34Z, and the frontend-proxy Service now routes only to the new pod. The new pod frontend-proxy-7b7cd5fb4-kwx2k is the only pod in the namespace with restarts: its frontend-proxy container is at restartCount 2 with last termination reason OOMKilled and exitCode 137 (finishedAt 22:30:50Z, current instance started 22:31:05Z, observed at 22:31:14Z); all 26 other pods are Running, ready, restartCount 0. The failures that the load generator recorded (aggregated fail ratio 0.67 -> 0.30, HTTP 500 on /api/products/1YMWWN1N4O, /api/products/L9ECAV7KIM, /api/products/OLJCESPC7Z and connection-refused on GET /) all plateaued by 22:28:35Z, i.e. during pod startup, and traces from 22:28:16Z to 22:28:34Z show HTTP 200 through frontend-proxy and frontend with rpc.grpc.status_code 0 on product-catalog and cart, so no request-level error attributable to the 22:28:34Z change was captured inside the authorized window (which ends 22:28:46Z; Jaeger's newest span starts 22:28:34.5Z). The leading explanation is that the injected duplicate FRONTEND_HOST=localhost makes the Envoy proxy build its frontend upstream against its own listener (localhost:8080), producing a request loop that exhausts the 65Mi limit and OOMKills the container; the alternative that the 65Mi limit alone is too small for this Envoy cannot be excluded because that limit is unchanged from the previous ReplicaSet. All flagd fault-injection flags are still defaultVariant "off", and no NetworkPolicy exists in the namespace.

claims.text: Deployment frontend-proxy in astronomy-shop has metadata.generation 2 and its managedFieldsSummary shows helm Apply at 2026-11-23T22:27:45Z followed by an Update by manager "OpenAPI-Generator" at 2026-11-23T22:28:34Z; its container env contains FRONTEND_HOST twice: once with value "frontend" and, appended last, once with value "localhost".

frontend-proxy is the only one of the 23 deployments in astronomy-shop whose managed fields were written by a manager other than helm: every other deployment shows only helm Apply at 2026-11-23T22:27:45Z and kube-controller-manager status updates, with generation 1.

ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-7b7cd5fb4 (created 2026-11-23T22:28:34Z) duplicates ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-579d54f6f5's pod template exactly (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.2.0-frontend-proxy, command envsubst < envoy.tmpl.yaml, resources.limits.memory 65Mi, securityContext runAsUser 101) except for one extra env entry FRONTEND_HOST=localhost appended after FRONTEND_HOST=frontend; the older ReplicaSet has FRONTEND_HOST=frontend only.

Kubernetes events in astronomy-shop record Deployment frontend-proxy ScalingReplicaSet 'Scaled up replica set frontend-proxy-7b7cd5fb4 from 0 to 1' at 2026-11-23T22:28:34Z, ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-7b7cd5fb4 SuccessfulCreate of pod frontend-proxy-7b7cd5fb4-kwx2k at 22:28:34Z, pod frontend-proxy-579d54f6f5-qk4lm Killing at 22:28:35Z and 'Scaled down replica set frontend-proxy-579d54f6f5 from 1 to 0' at 22:28:35Z.

The frontend-proxy Service (ClusterIP, port 8080 -> targetPort 8080) currently has a single endpoint, pod frontend-proxy-7b7cd5fb4-kwx2k (10.244.234.135 on sregym-worker), so all traffic for the proxy passes through the pod carrying the added FRONTEND_HOST=localhost entry.

Pod frontend-proxy-7b7cd5fb4-kwx2k (owned by ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-7b7cd5fb4) reports restartCount 2 for container frontend-proxy, lastState.terminated.reason OOMKilled with exitCode 137, startedAt 2026-11-23T22:29:42Z and finishedAt 2026-11-23T22:30:50Z; the container is currently running (startedAt 22:31:05Z) and Ready condition True since 22:31:05Z (object state observed at 22:31:14Z, after the authorized window end).

Across all 27 pods in astronomy-shop, frontend-proxy-7b7cd5fb4-kwx2k is the only pod with a restart count greater than 0 or a container that is not ready (restarts [frontend-proxy: 2, last termination OOMKilled], phase Running, ready true); every other pod is Running and ready with restartCount 0.

Load-generator data for astronomy-shop shows locust_requests_fail_ratio peaking at 0.6667 (22:28:05Z) and falling to 0.4364 (22:28:20Z) and 0.3038 (22:28:35Z), with locust_requests_num_requests Aggregated 9 -> 55 -> 79; per-endpoint failure counters are flat between 22:28:20Z and 22:28:35Z (GET / = 2, GET /api/products/1YMWWN1N4O = 2, GET /api/products/OLJCESPC7Z = 2, POST /api/checkout = 4 of 4 requests, POST /api/cart = 1 of 13), so the recorded failures occurred during pod startup and had stopped increasing before the frontend-proxy change.

locust_errors for astronomy-shop lists HTTPError('500 Server Error: Internal Server Error for url: /api/products/1YMWWN1N4O'), the same for /api/products/L9ECAV7KIM and /api/products/OLJCESPC7Z, plus ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused') for GET / and GET /api/products/66VCHSJNUP.

Traces from 22:28:16Z to 22:28:34Z show frontend-proxy spans 'GET' and 'router frontend egress' with http.status_code 200, frontend spans 'GET /api/products/{productId}', 'GET /api/products/[productId]/index', 'GET /api/cart', 'POST /api/cart' with http.status_code 200, and frontend client spans to oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and oteldemo.CartService with rpc.grpc.status_code 0; product-catalog spans 'oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' return rpc.grpc.status_code 0 in ~1ms.

ConfigMap flagd-config (demo.flagd.json) holds all demo fault-injection flags with defaultVariant "off": productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, adManualGc, adHighCpu, adFailure, cartFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, failedReadinessProbe, emailMemoryLeak, llmInaccurateResponse, llmRateLimitError, kafkaQueueProblems off (0), loadGeneratorFloodHomepage off (0), imageSlowLoad off (0).

The blackbox probes for this namespace use only the tcp_connect module (probe_success = TCP connect to the Service ClusterIP:port), so probe_success does not test HTTP semantics; between 22:27:50Z and 22:28:35Z probe_success was 0 then 1 for cart, currency, email, frontend-proxy, frontend, image-provider, kafka, product-catalog, product-reviews, quote and shipping, while ad, checkout, payment and recommendation stayed at 0 even though ad and recommendation served successful gRPC calls in traces at 22:28:31Z.
No NetworkPolicy exists in namespace astronomy-shop, so connection refusal between pods is not explained by a network policy at query time.

A flagd feature-flag fault (productCatalogFailure, adFailure, cartFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, failedReadinessProbe, emailMemoryLeak, llm* flags) was rejected as the cause: every such flag in ConfigMap flagd-config is at defaultVariant "off" and no fault-flag evidence ties it to the observed failures.

The 500s on product detail endpoints were considered as caused by product-catalog, but product-catalog spans at 22:28:31-22:28:34Z return rpc.grpc.status_code 0 in about 1ms and the failure counters stopped increasing by 22:28:35Z, consistent with startup warm-up rather than an ongoing product-catalog fault.

Leading mechanism: the injected duplicate env entry FRONTEND_HOST=localhost overrides the proxy's frontend upstream to its own listener (0.0.0.0:8080 / localhost:8080), so requests handled by frontend-proxy loop back into the proxy instead of reaching frontend, growing Envoy memory until the 65Mi container limit is hit and the container is OOMKilled (exitCode 137, restartCount 2) and repeatedly unavailable.

Alternative that remains open: the frontend-proxy container's unchanged 65Mi memory limit is simply too small for this Envoy build with 9 clusters and OTEL tracing, so the OOMKill would occur independently of the added FRONTEND_HOST=localhost entry; the pre-change ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-579d54f6f5 carried the same 65Mi limit but its pod lived only about 48 seconds (22:27:47Z-22:28:35Z), so it provides no counter-evidence either way.

Remove the duplicate FRONTEND_HOST=localhost entry from the frontend-proxy Deployment pod template so only FRONTEND_HOST=frontend remains, let the ReplicaSet roll, and then re-check the pod's restartCount/OOMKilled state and the load generator's failure counters per endpoint; also review whether 65Mi is an adequate memory limit for this Envoy configuration.

gaps: No request-level evidence exists for the period after the 22:28:34Z frontend-proxy change: the authorized window ends 2026-11-23T22:28:46Z, Jaeger's newest span starts 22:28:34.5Z, and frontend-proxy writes no access log to stdout, so the proxy's HTTP behaviour under the new pod config was not observed.

The OOMKilled termination (finishedAt 2026-11-23T22:30:50Z) and restartCount 2 are object state observed at 22:31:14Z, after the authorized window; objects cannot prove what was true at 22:28:46Z, and the metrics window does not extend past 22:28:46Z, so container memory growth and OOM events inside the window are unknown.

Prometheus retained samples only from about 22:27:45Z onward (all workloads were created then), so there is no pre-install baseline for locust failure ratio, probe_success, span error rate or latency for astronomy-shop; the 'ad', 'checkout', 'payment' and 'recommendation' probe_success=0 readings could not be compared with an earlier baseline.

The generated Envoy configuration (/envoy.yaml produced by envsubst inside the container) could not be read and no exec into the container is available, so which of the two FRONTEND_HOST values the running Envoy actually used is not verified.
The load-generator/load-gen workload is not present in the astronomy-shop pod list although locust metrics and traces from service load-generator exist, so its pod status and logs were not inspected.
Secrets in the namespace cannot be read, so any configuration held in Secrets was not verified.

The change-history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what applied the 22:28:34Z frontend-proxy update (manager name 'OpenAPI-Generator' only) and any earlier revisions could not be reviewed.
next_steps: Human review of the frontend-proxy Deployment revision history and of the actor named 'OpenAPI-Generator' that updated it at 2026-11-23T22:28:34Z.

After the window, capture frontend-proxy container memory usage and OOM events, the generated /envoy.yaml upstream addresses, and load-generator failure ratio per endpoint to confirm or refute the localhost-loop hypothesis.

Compare probe_success for ad, checkout, payment and recommendation against a later steady-state period to determine whether their TCP probes are a persistent environment artifact or a real connectivity problem.

Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind. When the API server returns zero objects of a kind other than events (every page read), the result is ok with total_items_processed 0: it proves only that there were no objects matching this kind, namespace and selectors at query time, not that none existed during the incident. Zero events, or a list your filter reduced to nothing, stays no_data. metadata.managedFieldsSummary gives each manager's last write time only: it is not a full change history (earlier writes by the same manager are gone) and it does not say which fields that write changed.

content:
global:
  evaluation_interval: 1m
  scrape_interval: 1m
  scrape_timeout: 10s
rule_files:
- /etc/config/recording_rules.yml
- /etc/config/alerting_rules.yml
- /etc/config/rules
- /etc/config/alerts
scrape_configs:
- job_name: kube-state-metrics
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: endpoints
  metric_relabel_configs:
  - action: drop
    regex: chaos-mesh|khaos
    source_labels:
    - namespace
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: .*kube-state-metrics.*
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_endpoints_name
- job_name: prometheus-self
  static_configs:
  - targets:
    - localhost:9090
- bearer_token_file: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]
  job_name: kubernetes-cadvisor
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
  metric_relabel_configs:
  - action: drop
    regex: chaos-mesh|khaos
    source_labels:
    - namespace
  relabel_configs:
  - replacement: kubernetes.default.svc:443
    target_label: __address__
  - regex: (.+)
    replacement: /api/v1/nodes/${1}/proxy/metrics/cadvisor
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_node_name
    target_label: __metrics_path__
  - action: labelmap
    regex: __meta_kubernetes_node_label_(.+)
  scheme: https
  tls_config:
    ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
    insecure_skip_verify: true
- job_name: node-exporter
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: endpoints
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter
    source_labels:
    - __meta_kubernetes_endpoints_name
# ---- Blackbox TCP probes for app service endpoints ----
# Probes each service's ClusterIP:port via the blackbox exporter.

- job_name: 'blackbox-astronomy-shop'
  metrics_path: /probe
  params:
    module: [tcp_connect]
  static_configs:
    - targets:
        - ad.astronomy-shop:8080
        - cart.astronomy-shop:8080
        - checkout.astronomy-shop:8080
        - currency.astronomy-shop:8080
        - email.astronomy-shop:8080
        - frontend.astronomy-shop:8080
        - frontend-proxy.astronomy-shop:8080
        - image-provider.astronomy-shop:8081
        - payment.astronomy-shop:8080
        - product-catalog.astronomy-shop:8080
        - product-reviews.astronomy-shop:3551
        - quote.astronomy-shop:8080
        - recommendation.astronomy-shop:8080
        - shipping.astronomy-shop:8080
        - flagd.astronomy-shop:8013
        - kafka.astronomy-shop:9092
      labels:
        namespace: astronomy-shop
  relabel_configs:
    - source_labels: [__address__]
      target_label: __param_target
    - source_labels: [__param_target]
      target_label: instance
    - target_label: __address__
      replacement: prometheus-prometheus-blackbox-exporter:9115

- job_name: 'blackbox-hotel-reservation'
  metrics_path: /probe
  params:
    module: [tcp_connect]
  static_configs:
    - targets:
        - frontend.hotel-reservation:5000
        - search.hotel-reservation:8082
        - profile.hotel-reservation:8081
        - geo.hotel-reservation:8083
        - rate.hotel-reservation:8084
        - recommendation.hotel-reservation:8085
        - user.hotel-reservation:8086
        - reservation.hotel-reservation:8087
      labels:
        namespace: hotel-reservation
  relabel_configs:
    - source_labels: [__address__]
      target_label: __param_target
    - source_labels: [__param_target]
      target_label: instance
    - target_label: __address__
      replacement: prometheus-prometheus-blackbox-exporter:9115

- job_name: 'hotel-reservation-application'
  static_configs:
    - targets:
        - search.hotel-reservation:9092
        - rate.hotel-reservation:9091
      labels:
        namespace: hotel-reservation

- job_name: 'blackbox-social-network'
  metrics_path: /probe
  params:
    module: [tcp_connect]
  static_configs:
    - targets:
        - nginx-thrift.social-network:8080
        - media-frontend.social-network:8081
        - user-service.social-network:9090
        - compose-post-service.social-network:9090
        - social-graph-service.social-network:9090
        - post-storage-service.social-network:9090
        - user-timeline-service.social-network:9090
        - url-shorten-service.social-network:9090
        - text-service.social-network:9090
        - unique-id-service.social-network:9090
        - user-mention-service.social-network:9090
        - home-timeline-service.social-network:9090
        - media-service.social-network:9090
      labels:
        namespace: social-network
  relabel_configs:
    - source_labels: [__address__]
      target_label: __param_target
    - source_labels: [__param_target]
      target_label: instance
    - target_label: __address__
      replacement: prometheus-prometheus-blackbox-exporter:9115
# ---- Ingress HTTP probes ----
- job_name: 'blackbox-ingress-hotel-reservation'
  metrics_path: /probe
  params:
    module: [http_2xx]
  scrape_interval: 15s
  static_configs:
    - targets:
        - http://ingress-nginx-controller.ingress-nginx/api/hotels?inDate=2015-04-09&outDate=2015-04-10&lat=38.0235&lon=-122.095
      labels:
        namespace: hotel-reservation
  relabel_configs:

# ---- OTel Collector spanmetrics (Jaeger traces) ----
- job_name: 'otel-spanmetrics'
  scrape_interval: 15s
  static_configs:
    - targets:
        - otel-collector.observe:8889
  metric_relabel_configs:
    # Strip "unknown_service:" prefix and "_process" suffix from blueprint-hotel-reservation service names
    # e.g. unknown_service:frontend_service_process -> frontend_service
    - source_labels: [service_name]
      regex: 'unknown_service:(.+)_process'
      target_label: service_name
      replacement: '$1'
    # Drop wlgen metrics — not a real service
    - source_labels: [service_name]
      regex: 'unknown_service:wlgen_proc'
      action: drop
    # Use the namespace attached to the trace, not a service-name guess.
    - source_labels: [k8s_namespace_name]
      regex: '(.+)'
      target_label: namespace
      replacement: '$1'
